title: ornithogalum exscapum var. collinum
intro: Ornithogalum exscapum var. collinum, commonly known as the climbing starflower, is a type of flowering plant in the Asparagaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Ornithogalum exscapum var. collinum include analgesic, antispasmodic, and sedative effects, making it useful for treating anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
